rows.en: Touya: "...So, we're going to the research facility. What's the plan?
Are we going to charge in with Spirit Mechs and take it over?"
Clovis: "Well, we can be pretty sure it's armed.
But if we smash through its defenses head-on,
they'll erase the data that proves what they're doing,
and then they'll paint us as invaders.
That's just the sort of thing they'd do. To prevent that, we'll infiltrate
the place and get the evidence. Then we'll take it over."
Ai: "Infiltrate...? We've never even been there,
and it's a facility where they're doing research in secret.
How are we supposed to get in?"
Bart: "...No problem. I have a floor plan of the facility here."
Aurelie: "Where do you keep getting these things...?"
Bart: "...Heh."
Xiujian: "That's quite a detailed floor plan.
...Hmm. This must be the research section in question...
We may be able to manage with this."
Kururu: "All right! Let's sneak in! Let's sneak in!"
Clovis: "You're staying behind."
Kururu: "Aww!"
Ai: "That's right. Leave this sort of thing to us..."
Clovis: "You, too."
Ai: "What?!"
Clovis: "Look. If we all go in, then all come back,
and only then take over, that's inefficient, right?
A small team will infiltrate. Once we've secured the evidence,
we'll start the takeover."
Aurelie: "But will the infiltration team be all right?
Shouldn't you have at least five people?"
Xiujian: "One person to oversee the operation, a pair
to carry out those instructions, and another pair...
You need both action and support."
Clovis: "We can't spare five, but four of us will go in."
Ai: "Huh? There's Clovis... Then Xiujian.
Then Touya... Wait, who's the fourth?"
Derock: "...That would be me."
Yamato: "What?!"
Clovis: "Personality and ability are separate things.
We don't have much choice here."
Derock: "Heh heh. Covert operations like this are my specialty.
My very finest specialty. These 'secretly taken photos of Lady Celica'
are ample proof of that."
Touya: "Hm? Let me see..."
Touya: "Ow! What was that for?!"
Ai: "Don't you two have any sense of decency?!
...I'm confiscating these."
Derock: "...Oh, I'd like those back..."
Ai: "...Honestly, I can't let my guard down for a second."
Derock: "But that's all right.
I can just make more prints. Guh heh heh heh."
Aurelie: "He's hopeless."
Kururu: "You creep."
Miyasco: "We'll reach the designated position shortly."
Ai: "...So the research facility's up ahead."
Aurelie: "We just wait for your signal before launching,
right?"
Clovis: "Yeah. Or if our regular signal
stops coming."
Ai: "H-Hold on! You mean if something
happens to you? Is it that dangerous?!"
Xiujian: "...It's just a precaution."
Ai: "But..."
Aurelie: "Ai. We just have to trust them and wait.
Otherwise, they won't be able to go without worrying about us, will they?"
Kururu: "That's right. You worry too much!"
Ai: "W-What?! Aren't you worried?!"
Kururu: "Not at all. I believe in them.
Besides, my future husband isn't that weak.
Right, Touya?"
Touya: "I told you, don't just decide I'm your husband.
...But if we don't pull this off and stop the plan from going ahead,
the damage will spread. I'm prepared for some danger."
Ai: "Touya..."
Touya: "Well, I'm off. I'll be back."
Ai: "D-Don't go dragging everyone down."
Touya: "Like I'd do that.
Just be a good girl and wait here."
Ai: "...Be careful."
Touya: "Yeah."
Clovis: "...All right, then...?
Hey, what happened to the big guy?"
Xiujian: "No idea..."
Sisk: "Huh? I thought he was right there a moment ago..."
Miyasco: "?! This feeling... It couldn't be..."
Sisk: "...Ah!"
Touya: "What's wrong?"
Sisk: "Th-There!"
Clovis: "An Armored Mech?! What about the radar?!"
Sisk: "I-It's working normally! There's no radar contact!"
Ai: "What?! Don't tell me they've got optical cloaking
too!"
Touya: "Hey, have they spotted us?!"
Xiujian: "Our optical cloaking is active.
But those movements..."
Aurelie: "There doesn't seem to be any doubt."
Kururu: "Wh-What do we do?"
Touya: "If they've caught on, we can't just run."
Yamato: "Even if we use area isolation like before and cut off
their communications, they'd notice the sounds of battle,
but the same goes if we just stay like this..."
Kururu: "...Hey, I've never seen a mech like that.
Is it really an enemy?"
Miyasco: "...That mech is a Rayal Klose...
It's definitely something created by 'Code 3.'"
Ai: "...What?"
Sisk: "Miyasco... You..."
Clovis: "What does the mech identification say?!"
Sisk: "What? Oh, yes... Um,
there's no matching data!"
Aurelie: "...Looks like there's no mistake. Anyway,
shouldn't we do something about that thing first?"
Xiujian: "You're right. We have no choice."
Touya: "All right! Let's go!"
Clovis: "In that case, we're going straight for the facility!"
Aurelie: "You're going to take it over right away?"
Clovis: "Yeah. While we still have a chance."
Xiujian: "...If this is their defensive perimeter,
the facility itself will be lightly guarded.
Even one Spirit Mech should be enough."
Ai: "So, as long as one of us breaks through
and reaches the facility, we're good?"
Clovis: "Given the situation, Rayblade would be best.
It should help intimidate them, too."
Xiujian: "Leave holding them off to me."
Touya: "Got it. When I reach the facility, I give them a warning
and watch for any suspicious moves, right?"
Clovis: "Yeah. I'm counting on you."
Yamato: "Anywhere around here will do.
Touya, let's go!"
Touya: "All right! Let's go, everyone!"
Kururu: "Yeah!"
Ai: "Touya, I'm going to do things my way."
Arthur: "I'm sorry, but this time I'll act
on my own."
Clovis: "I'll operate alone. I'm leaving your side to you."
Aurelie: "Sorry, but I can't put my life in your hands yet.
I'll do things my way."
Xiujian: "...I have no intention of following your orders.
I'll act as I see fit."
Celica: "Sorry, but I can't follow your orders this time."
Fain: "The burning soul of justice still doesn't
dwell within you! I cannot follow the orders of such a person!
So I shall follow my own justice! That is all!"
Melissa: "I'll be acting on my own this time."
Kururu: "I'll fight however I like."
Leone: "I'm not sure I can follow Touya's orders
properly. So I'll do things my own way this time."

Touya: "...Hm?"
Yamato: "Something doesn't look right..."
Zigrim Soldier: "Ugh... Ghh... Agh!"

Aurelie: "We may still make it... Touya!"
